_recipe.title: Stats report
_recipe.when: A year / quarter in numbers, an impact report, investor or all-hands update, campaign results. YouTube, LinkedIn, website, presentations (16:9).
beats: Hook: the single biggest number, counting up, with the period as the kicker.
Trend: growth over time as bars, the latest period highlighted.
Highlights: four headline metrics as tiles (label = number + noun, sub = context).
Then vs now: last period vs this period, two rows each.
Second hero number: the metric people will quote.
Voice: a short quote from a customer, partner or the founder.
What's next: three plans as big dimming lines.
CTA: read the full report / get in touch.
copyTips: Every number is the user's: the bar values in this recipe (0.8 / 1.2 / 1.7 / 2.4) are samples. Replace all of them and keep one unit per chart.
Round for the screen ("2.4M", "98%") and give the exact figure in the report, not the video.
The bars highlight defaults to the largest value; set "highlight" to the latest period if growth is not monotonic.
Corporate + smooth + relaxed lets numbers land. Dark keynote look: --theme studio-dark. Bold internal update: --theme mono.
For LinkedIn feed use --format portrait (keeps under 60s); for a reel cut, drop beats 4 and 6 first.
